Elena / Marcus — thanks for the questionnaire. Attached is our completed worksheet (Redwood_Filled_Questionnaire.xlsx) and the high-level security summary again for your records. Below are concise answers to the items you flagged and proposed next steps.

Short answers: 
- BYOK / Customer-managed keys: Yes. We support customer-managed keys via integrations with major cloud KMS providers (AWS KMS, Google Cloud KMS, Azure Key Vault). For Private/on-prem deployments we offer HSM-backed key storage and can support FIPS 140-2 validated HSMs on request.
- In-transit encryption: TLS 1.2 and 1.3 supported; mutual TLS (mTLS) available for Private deployments and dedicated VPN/VPC peering setups.
- Key rotation: Keys can be rotated programmatically. We support scheduled rotation and on-demand rotate; for BYOK scenarios we provide guidance and tooling to rotate with minimal or zero downtime depending on cache/windowing configuration.
- Logging & audit: Key usage and access events are logged to our control plane audit logs. For hosted customers we retain audit logs for 90 days by default; longer retention is available as an add-on or via streaming logs to a customer SIEM (S3, Event Hub, Pub/Sub integrations documented in the questionnaire).
- SOC 2: We have a current SOC 2 Type II report (2025 audit). A redacted copy is available under NDA — link to request form included in the attached workbook and via DocuSign for our standard NDA/limited redaction.
- HIPAA / BAA: We support PHI workloads and do execute BAAs. For PHI requiring air-gapped environments we offer Private on-prem packages — we'll need to scope infra/networking with your engineering team.

Attachments: Redwood_Filled_Questionnaire.xlsx (completed), Redwood_Security_Summary.pdf (att. 2)

1) Tech review call (30 min) with your security/infra: Vivek (security lead) + Grace (solutions) — proposed slots Wed 10:00am or Thu 2:00pm PST. Please confirm which works.
2) If you want the SOC 2 Type II redacted report, sign the NDA/Redaction agreement here: https://docusign.com/records/BAA-ACME-2026 (link in worksheet).
3) For BAAs or Private/on-prem discussions, loop in procurement/legal — we've included a one-page BAA process note in the attached workbook.

Let me know which next step you prefer and I'll get the calendar invite out. Thanks again — look forward to moving this forward.
